description: 행정안전부_지진재해대응시스템_행정구역정보 [earthquakes and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 행정안전부의 지진재해대응시스템 행정구역정보 데이터는 「지진재해대책법」 제1조(목적) 및 제7조(지진가속도계측과 관리) 등 법령에 따라, 지진 진도 분포 및 피해 예측에 필요한 공간정보를. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 행정구역, 위경도, 명칭 정보, 지진대응, 진도분포 및 피해추정. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
